notes.title: Our game is in the DevGAMM Awards!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey guys! Our tiny game is participating in a [b]huge award[/b] — the [b]DevGAMM Awards Community Vote[/b]! [b]Many drops make a shower[/b], so let’s work together to collect some points! 🎮
[b]Help us win by voting here: [url="https://devgamm.fillout.com/community-vote2025"]https://devgamm.fillout.com/community-vote2025[/url][/b][/p][p][/p][p]1 vote per person. Voting ends on [b]Oct 5[/b].
And thank you so much for your support — not just here, but for all the kind words you’ve written and shared about [b]Invisible Wall[/b]! 🙌[/p]

notes.title: Now on macOS + controller support
notes.notes:
[p]🍏 Released on [b]macOS[/b]! Now the Apple lords can also find out who our mysterious stranger is.
🎮 Controller support: [b]Steam Deck[/b], [b]PlayStation[/b], and [b]Xbox[/b]. Not sure about Switch — too poor to buy and test it.
🪲 Fixed a couple of bugs. If you find more, drop a message in the update comments, on Twitter: [url="https://x.com/righthandlab"]https://x.com/righthandlab[/url], or by email: righthandlab.contact@gmail.com[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
🔧 Hotfix: “Missing Game Executable” and Minor Fixes

- We've received several reports over the weekend about the game failing to launch after Friday's update. This hotfix should resolve the issue.
If you're still experiencing problems, please don’t hesitate to contact us at righthandlab.contact@gmail.com.
- Fixed dialogue line order in a couple of spots.

notes.title: Invisible Wall is out now!
notes.notes:
[p]We’ve just released our visual novel!
Inspired by [i]Milk inside a bag of milk[/i] and [i]The Mandela Catalogue[/i], it focuses on psychological horror rooted in everyday reality.[/p][p]We hope the story connects with you, as it feels personal for some members of our team.[/p][p]Wishing you a meaningful experience![/p]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Livestream: Demo Playthrough with All Endings
notes.notes: [p]Join us during Steam Next Fest! Your choices shape the protagonist’s personality, influencing her behavior. In this stream, we’ll show how to unlock all three personality types.[/p]

notes.title: Discover Livber: Smoke and Mirrors, an interactive story from our friends
notes.notes:
If you enjoy narrative-driven games, this one might stay with you too.

Livber: Smoke and Mirrors is a short psychological horror interactive story. Five years after vanishing without a trace, the woman you once called your lover writes from beyond the silence: "I will give birth to your child.” In three acts, descend into a fractured mindscape where obsession, memory, and myth intertwine.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3700580/?utm_source=steam&utm_campaign=invisible_wall

notes.title: Check out our demo at Steam Next Fest, June 9–16 — full launch is coming soon!
notes.notes:
As they love to say on LinkedIn — we’re [i]thrilled[/i] to announce that we’re part of Steam Next Fest, and ready to stream our demo for the very first time!

Get a first look at the beginning of [i]Invisible Wall[/i], our dark and unsettling visual novel. [b]Add it to your wishlist to stay updated![/b]

See you there, June 9–16, 2025.
